app.name: Bliss
app.description: A warm, nature-inspired wedding planning companion. Step by step through the garden.

marketing.subhead: Bliss guides you through every stage of planning, from first vision to wedding day, like a calm friend who has done this before.
marketing.ctaNote: Free to start. No credit card required.

dreamFirst.title: Dream first, budget later
dreamFirst.body: We start with your vision. Budget comes after, framed as how to make it happen, not a ceiling.

oneStep.title: {count} quests, one step at a time
oneStep.body: Every quest is open from day one. You always know what to do next, and what can wait.

multicultural.title: Built for two families
multicultural.body: Blending traditions? Pick your heritages and Bliss adds the right events, vendors, and lead times.

quote.text: Bliss feels like a friend who has already been through it.

money.regionalNote: Costs vary a lot by region. Expect higher in NY, CA, and NJ, lower in the Midwest and South.

time.leadTime: Book {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} out

join.title: Joining your wedding plan
join.redirecting: Taking you to your shared plan.
